useCase: Atlas and spatial navigation: map-like vaults, MOCs, region indexes and location journals where the reader moves across an overview rather than down a linear note.
distinctFeatures: Decorative survey texture between Reading view blocks and outside the Live Preview text column
Diamond waypoint markers prefix H1-H2 in Reading view and Live Preview
Callouts and code blocks carry a coloured route rail on the inline-start edge
Dotted border cues on internal links and dashed unresolved links
Horizon rule with a centred waypoint glyph

fonts.interface: "Gill Sans", "Gill Sans MT", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
